senses.gloss: f. (קבס, cmp. כבש, a. Syr. קפס, קפסותא P. Sm. 3695, sq.) repression, intermission (of prophetic revelation).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:2">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> <he>חנניה</he> … <he>אלא שהיה לו וכ׳</he> Hananiah … was a true prophet, but he had an intermission (his gift of prophecy was in abeyance), and hearing what Jeremiah prophesied &c.
